page_title: BAY 1-1 LEV | Bayern Munich v Bayer Leverkusen 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Felix Zwayer is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.

90+5' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Felix Zwayer with no other option than to blow for a foul. That's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen.

90+4' Joshua Kimmich sprays a wonderful pass out to Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Lukas Hradecky problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the left post.
90+3' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) picks out Nathan Tella with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
90+2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a long ball forward to Leroy Sane, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
90+1' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Alejandro Grimaldo is replaced by Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen).
90+1' Today's match ends for Florian Wirtz who will be replaced by Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.

87' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
86' Felix Zwayer interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen). It's a free kick to Bayern Munich, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

57' It's unbelievable, Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards the right post from a few yards out, but Lukas Hradecky reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
57' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
